abilities.gameText: Nekromar's axes are glowing a cobalt blue. The glowing increases and suddenly covers his whole body. Before anyone is able to react, his axes start hitting each group member.
abilities.notes: Mass damage for the entire group ~400-500 damage

abilities.gameText: Nekromar changes his strategy and no longer directly hits his opponent, but hits his neighbour instead.
abilities.notes: Nekromar will ignore hitting the tank and will hit whoever is next in line after your tank (depends on how you have placed your NPCs)

abilities.gameText: Nekromar raises his hands to his chest, speaks the magic words and thrusts his hands towards the group. During the next 2 rounds, all attacks pass through him, but blood is suddenly splattering out of the open wounds of the attacker.
abilities.notes: All attacks against Nekromar will hit for 0 damage and also he will retaliate some of them back to the attacker. Nekromar counters {attacking NPC's} attack. {attacking NPC's} receive 50-100 damage.

abilities.gameText: Nekromar's back wings are starting to shiver and are suddenly covered in icicles. It is getting cold around him. A glassy layer of ice is spreading on the floor and heading towards the group. Everyone has a hard time trying not to fall on the floor. After 2 rounds, the layer of ice dissolves.
abilities.notes: Next 2 rounds the entire group (excepts the Tank) will skip rounds and will not attack

abilities.gameText: Nekromar spins in a circle and creates a magic swirl. A magical shield appears and covers the whole body of Nekromar. The shield will lose his effect after 10 Rounds.
abilities.notes: He casts a shield on him reducing damage taken

abilities.gameText: Nekromar speaks a quick incantation. Surrounded by a green light his wounds begin to close.
abilities.notes: Nekromar heals himself for ~1051 Healing and Critical for 2102 Healing

abilities.gameText: Trakovar`s whip smacks through the air and blue sparks fly as it hits {Random NPC}`s hand. He is crippled for 3 rounds.
abilities.notes:
or if it misses

**Trakovar`s whip smacks through the air and blue sparks fly as his whips become entangled and his attack fails.**

The affected NPC will be doing insufficient damage for 3 rounds. This ability seems to be missing a lot.

abilities.gameText: The end of the whip wraps itself around {Random NPC} and shackles him for 3 rounds.
abilities.notes: The affected NPC will not take part in the next 3 rounds at all

abilities.gameText: The whips mercilessly smack down on the group. It`s impossible to know where they will hit and therefore impossible to avoid them.
abilities.notes: Hits the entire group for 1200-1400 damage. The attack can miss some NPCs.

abilities.gameText: A loud roar echoes from the barbarian`s throat when he issues a sweeping blow. The blade cuts through the air so quickly that it becomes blurred. No one had a chance of escaping.
abilities.notes: Mass damage to the entire group for 1400-1500 damage. The attack can double hit, crit or miss.

abilities.gameText: Recognition gleams in the barbarians` eyes. He has spotted your combat tactic and is nimbly evading all dangerous attacks.
abilities.notes: Seems to be increasing the chance to miss an attack on Kratos, meaning that your attack can still damage him if they don't miss.

abilities.gameText: Gernasch breathes in deeply and blows a cloud of smoke, enveloping {random NPC}. {random NPC} loses orientation for 4 rounds.
abilities.notes: {random NPC} will have higher chance to miss an attack (not confirmed what it actually does)

abilities.gameText: A blue flash of lightning hits {random NPC}, but he remains completely uninjured.
abilities.notes:
or it hits successfully

**A blue flash of lightning hits {random NPC} and weakens him for 4 rounds.**

(not confirmed what it actually does)

abilities.gameText: Fenrirson attacks {randon NPC} with a ferocious leap.
abilities.notes: Deals 1000 damage

abilities.gameText: Fenrirson releases a fear-inducing cry that fills all group members with terrifying fear.
abilities.notes:
Seems to be lowering Dexterity of the group

**Random number of {randon NPCs} runs like mad from Fenrirson.**

Skipping the round fleeing in fear

abilities.gameText: Zagrash does a jump in the air and thrusts his fists together. As he comes back down to the floor, he slams his fists on the ground with full force. An earthquake jolts the group for 1 rounds.
abilities.notes: It seems that this ability makes most of the group not to take action in the round, only some of the NPCs

abilities.gameText: Zagrash raises his hands to his chest, speaks the magic words and thrusts his hands towards the group. During the next 4 rounds, all attacks pass through him, but blood is suddenly splattering out of the open wounds of the attacker.
abilities.notes: For the next 4 rounds all attacks do 0 damage to Zagrash and he will counter attack these attacks for damage back to the attacker (100-200 damage)

abilities.gameText: Zagrash spins in a circle and creates a magic swirl. A magical shield appears and covers the whole body of Zagrash. The shield will lose his effect after 15 Rounds.
abilities.notes: He casts a shield on himself that absorbs a lot of damage (not sure how many but most attacks will do 0 damage anyway but it will say Zagrash absorbs 0 damage)

abilities.gameText: Zagrash`s hands are glowing a cobalt blue. The glowing increases and suddenly covers his whole body. Before anyone is able to react, he starts hitting each group member with his weapons.
abilities.notes: This is the deadliest attack out there. At the start of the round he will do mass damage to the entire group for 900-100 damage which can double hit and critical hit for 2000 damage!

abilities.gameText: Zagrash draws a cross in the air and throw his fist in the direction of {random NPC}.
abilities.notes: Not sure if it does anything

abilities.gameText: Zagrash draws a mirror in the air. All actions from {random NPC} are suddenly reversed. The spell loses its power after 5 rounds.
abilities.notes:
or if it misses

**Zagrash depicts a mirror in the air. The group is glad that nothing has happened.**

Not sure what it does when it hits

abilities.gameText: Zagrash describes a cross in the air and throws his fist towards {random NPC}. Magical energy hits {random NPC} and disables {random NPC}'s tongue.
abilities.notes: The {random NPC} will skip this round

abilities.gameText: Zagrash speaks a quick incantation. Surrounded by a green light his wounds begin to close.
abilities.notes: Zagrash heals himself for 1320 healing (capable of critical heal)

dungeons.name: Chamber of Pyro
dungeons.dungeonPoints: 10-21. Most of the times it will be between 10-14. 21 is hypothetically the worst luck possible

abilities.gameText: Pyro takes a deep breath and blows a cloud of smoke in the direction of {random NPC}, the cloud disappears before it can reach {random NPC}
abilities.notes:
**OR Pyro breathes in deeply and blows a cloud of smoke, enveloping {random NPC}. {random NPC} loses orientation for 2 rounds.**

It's an attack on random NPC of your group which misses quite a lot but if it succeeds, the targeted NPC will not attack/take action for 2 rounds

abilities.gameText: Pyro changes his strategy and no longer directly hits his opponent, but hits his neighbour instead.
abilities.notes: Every two rounds Pyro will not hit the tank but his neighbour. This is the Mercenary you in your next Mercenary slot.

abilities.gameText: Pyro speaks a short spell. A red light surrounds him and he seems to be able to foresee all attacks on him.
abilities.notes: Seems like an attack that increases the chance to miss Pyro in this round of attacks

abilities.gameText: Nithotep softly whispers to the wind. Her seductive sound infiltrates {random NPC}'s spirit and poisons his body for 5 rounds
abilities.notes: The affected NPC receives ~124 damage per round for the next 5 rounds.

abilities.gameText: Smiling, Nithotep breaks a small talisman. Her figure becomes invisible for a short time. For 4 rounds, your weapons cannot find their target and every attack is punished with a bolt of lightning from ethereal energy.
abilities.notes: Every successful attack against Nithotep also damages the attack for ~20 damage.

abilities.gameText: With dark words, Nithotep asks Seth to stand by her. Her request does not remain unheard. Green light shoots out of her wounds, reassembling flesh and bone.
abilities.notes: Nithotep heals herself for ~2194 healing. Can crit

abilities.gameText: Papa Sasama raises his hands to his chest, speaks the magic words and thrusts his hands towards the group. During the next 3 rounds, all attacks pass through him, but blood is suddenly splattering out of the open wounds of the attacker.
abilities.notes: Papa Sasama receives 0 damage from attacks for the next 3 rounds. Also he counter's back some attacks for the amount of the damage done

abilities.gameText: Papa Sasama spins in a circle and creates a magic swirl. A magical shield appears and covers the whole body of Papa Sasama. The shield will lose his effect after 5 Rounds.
abilities.notes: He casts a shield on himself that absorbs damage. It lasts for 5 rounds or until it absorbs 600 damage. The idea is that the shield lasts for 5 rounds and he re-applies it every 5 rounds so you just have to out damage it

abilities.gameText: Papa Sasama draws a cross in the air and throw his fist in the direction of {random NPC}
Papa Sasama draws a mirror in the air. All actions from {random NPC} are suddenly reversed. The spell loses its power after 2 rounds.
abilities.notes:
If cast on your healer, the healer will do damage equal to the heal to your NPC that was supposed to receive the healing. If cast on a damage dealer, the attack will instead heal Papa Sasama. Example:

Murmillo hits Papa Sasama. Papa Sasama receives 187 healing

Skarsburning heals Murmillo.  Murmillo receives 1501 damage

abilities.gameText: Papa Sasama speaks a quick incantation. Surrounded by a green light his wounds begin to close.
abilities.notes: Papa Sasama heals himself for ~1350 healing (can also Crit heal)

abilities.gameText: Papa Sasama describes a cross in the air and throws his fist towards {randon NPC}. Magical energy hits Elite Spear Carrier and disables Elite Spear Carrier's tongue.
abilities.notes: Makes the affected NPC to probably miss hitting at all

abilities.gameText: Shetu bin Seth retreats behind his armour. For 3 rounds your blades cannot find a weak point to attack.
abilities.notes: It seems that i sometimes let the attackers do 0 damage

abilities.gameText: The more effort {random NPC} puts in, the more bored Shetu bin Seth seems to become. For 3 the effect of the presence of {random NPC} is reduced.
abilities.notes: Doesn't seem to do anything significant to the affected NPC

abilities.gameText: Ominous dark clouds gather above Shetu bin Seth. Blood-red lightning bolts flash in the night sky and an unholy wind howls through the air, throwing stones and sand into the air. For 4 rounds every word is swallowed up by the storm. Sand in your eyes makes combat more difficult and debris has become a lethal weapon.
abilities.notes: The storm hurls pieces of stone around and hits the entire group for 100 damage and this is repeated for 4 rounds

abilities.gameText: The poisonous vapours that surround the creatures gradually start weakening you more and more. All group members lose 1% of their damage value and their healing capability.
abilities.notes: Mass debuff every round on the entire group losing 1% damage and 1% healing. This means that the longer the fight goes on the weaker the group is

abilities.gameText: Corruption delights in her victim`s pain
abilities.notes: Also, Corruption will heal for 50% of the damage she does in the attack

abilities.gameText: A tentacle shoots out of the ground and wraps itself around {random NPC}. He will need 3 rounds to liberate himself from its grasp.
abilities.notes: The affected {random NPC} will not participate in the next 3 rounds

abilities.gameText: With a rough throaty sound Akhekhu spews out a poisonous bile and spits it right into {random NPC}'s face. This will additionally weaken {random NPC}'s body for 5 rounds.
abilities.notes:
The poison weakens {random NPC} for 622 damage

The affected NPC will take 622 damage every round for 5 rounds

abilities.gameText: An obnoxious scent exudes from the creature's mouth and dazes all your senses. Your group will not be able to concentrate well for the next 3 rounds. This prevents any healing and weakens your attacks.
abilities.notes: The healer will not heal for next 3 rounds and chance for every NPC not to attack/action at all and miss its attacks

abilities.gameText: Akhekhu starts rocking hypnotically and a beautiful song fills the air. Every group member that cannot resist it, will not be able to move for 3 rounds.
abilities.notes: Chance for some NPCs to resist it. The ones who resist will be able to attack and action in the next 3 rounds. The ones affected will not take part in the round at all

abilities.gameText: Lord Aesteron hits {random NPC} in the head with the hilt of his sword. {random NPC} looses his orientation for 4 rounds.
abilities.notes: This is if Lord Aesteron's attack is successful. If it misses it will be **Lord Aesteron swings a sword knob at {random NPC}, who knowingly perceives this diabolic plan and steps to the side.** This is a extra attack made by Lord Aesteron on a random NPC. If it succeeds the affected NPC will not take part in the next 4 rounds.

abilities.gameText: Lord Aesteron changes his strategy and no longer directly hits his opponent, but hits his neighbour instead.
abilities.notes: Just like Pyro, every 7 rounds he will not attack the Tank but he will attack whoever you have next in NPC order.

abilities.gameText: Lord Aesteron draws a mirror in the air. All actions from {random NPC} are suddenly reversed. The spell loses its power after 3 rounds.
abilities.notes: This is if the spell succeeds. If it doesn't it says **Lord Aesteron depicts a mirror in the air. The group is glad that nothing has happened.** If successful, randomly affects 1 NPC and prevents it from taking action in the next 3 rounds.

abilities.gameText: Lord Aesteron speaks a quick incantation. Surrounded by a green light his wounds begin to close.
abilities.notes: Lord Aesteron will heal himself for ~755 healing

abilities.gameText: Oak Lord makes the attackers unable to move for 1 round(s) and withdraws health from them.
abilities.notes: It's a mass damage to the entire group for 100 damage to each NPC and heals Oak Lord for the same amount

abilities.gameText: Oak Lord breathes deeply and spouts a cloud of toxic fumes at the attacker.
abilities.notes: Another mass damage spell that will hit the entire group for 250 damage

abilities.gameText: Homo Nautilus speaks a short spell. A red light surrounds him and he seems to be able to foresee all attacks on him.
abilities.notes: Seems like an increased chance to miss attacks against him

abilities.gameText: Homo Nautilus speaks a magic incantation. {random NPC} is distracted by it for 2 Rounds.
abilities.notes: Affected NPC will miss its attacks on Homo Nautilus for the next 2 rounds

abilities.gameText: Homo Nautilus spits out a slimy liquid. Your whole group has a hard time keeping on their feet.
abilities.notes: Seems like an increased chance to miss attacks against him

abilities.gameText: Homo Nautilus scares {random NPC} away with a blood-curdling scream. {random NPC} is visibly scared and fights even more defensively.
abilities.notes: Deals 0 damage or misses the entire attack

abilities.gameText: Homo Nautilus draws a cross in the air and throw his fist in the direction of {random NPC}.
abilities.notes: Deals 0 damage or misses the entire attack

abilities.gameText: Frank N. Stein's axes are glowing a cobalt blue. The glowing increases and suddenly covers his whole body. Before anyone is able to react, his axes start hitting each group member.
abilities.notes: Mass damage to the entire dungeon group for ~530 damage. The attack can be blocked or can crit or be reduced by Armour. The attack can also miss.

abilities.gameText: Frank N. Stein raises his hands to his chest, speaks the magic words and thrusts his hands towards the group. During the next 5 rounds, all attacks pass through him, but blood is suddenly splattering out of the open wounds of the attacker.
abilities.notes: All attacks against Frank N. Stein deal 0 damage for the next 5 rounds

abilities.gameText: Frank N. Steins mouth, located in his stomach, opens and spouts a huge fountain of blood towards the group. It takes 2 rounds for everyone to clean the dripping blood from themselves.
abilities.notes: All affected NPCs are skipping 2 rounds. Doesn't seem to affect everyone in the group. Might be random

abilities.gameText: Frank N. Stein speaks a quick incantation. Surrounded by a green light his wounds begin to close.
abilities.notes: Frank N. Stein heals himself at the start of the round. ~1350 healing or ~2700 critical heal

dungeons.name: Externsteine
dungeons.dungeonPoints: 6 (if you start with Tree Shepherd and ignore the Fanatics)

abilities.gameText: Wrath Mountain spouts a flame jet at {random NPC}. The flame jet burns {random NPC} for 4.
abilities.notes: Wrath Mountain burns the entire group for 250-500 damage and this will repeat for 4 rounds. During this turn with the flame jets, Wrath Mountain will not make a normal hit. The {random NPC} will be "on fire" for another 500 damage that same round

abilities.gameText: Valerius Filius Gustavo makes a sign in the air and three small vortexes charge at the group.
abilities.notes: The vortex hits 3 random targets for 1000-1500 damage

abilities.gameText: Valerius Filius Gustavo spits out 3 beams of water that fire upon the group.
abilities.notes: The water beam hits 3 random targets for 500-1000 damage

abilities.gameText: Valerius Filius Gustavo forms a circle in front of their chest using their hands and creates a fireball.
abilities.notes: The fireball hits all 5 group members for 500-1500 damage

abilities.gameText: Valerius Filius Gustavo stamps on the ground and the earth starts to rear up in breaking waves.
abilities.notes: The wave of earth hits all 5 group members for 500-1500 damage

abilities.gameText: Dubnovellaunus channels all his strength with unswerving focus. All enemy attacks break harmlessly over his steely determination, and are reflected back at the attacker with devastating force.
abilities.notes: All attacks against him this round do 0 damage.

abilities.gameText: Dubnovellaunus brings his weapon crashing down with brutal force. His victim stumbles back, stunned, seeing nothing but stars as their consciousness fades.
abilities.notes: Some mercenaries do not attack at all this round. Neither is Dubnovellaunus.

abilities.gameText: Whirling around with brute force, Dubnovellaunus deals a sweeping attack which downs his enemies in a shower of splintering metal and bone.
abilities.notes: Does AoE damage to the entire dungeon party

abilities.gameText: A hazy shimmer surrounds Evil Fairy Queen Clíodhna, as she is protected by a shield of pure energy, causing every blow to bounce off harmlessly in a shower of sparks.
abilities.notes: The shield absorbs 3,000 damage and lasts until it breaks or 4 rounds pass. A blow that breaks it carries the rest of its damage through.

abilities.gameText: Evil Fairy Queen Clíodhna pounds the ground with an almighty thud, sending cracks through the earth, inflicting a paralysing weakness over her enemies that saps even powers of healing.
abilities.notes: No effect has been seen yet; sometimes the game says the pounding has no effect at all.

abilities.gameText: Seized by a raging fury, Evil Fairy Queen Clíodhna lets loose a deafening roar, and her attacks strike down with twice the force, leaving nothing but devastation in their wake.
abilities.notes: Her next attack does double damage. A miss uses it up.
